summary_short.zh: LLMs-from-scratch 是一个教育性开源项目，通过从零实现类ChatGPT大语言模型，帮助开发者深入理解LLM的工作原理。项目采用PyTorch和Jupyter Notebook逐步讲解Transformer架构、注意力机制等核心概念，让学习者亲手搭建完整模型。这种实践方式不仅揭示了LLM内部机制，还提供了可修改的代码基础，开发者可在此基础上调整模型结构、训练自己的语言模型，或将其作为学习深度学习和自然语言处理的实践平台。

summaries.en: LLMs-from-scratch is an educational project that demystifies large language models by guiding users through building a ChatGPT-like model from the ground up. It teaches core concepts like transformer architecture and attention mechanisms through hands-on PyTorch implementation in Jupyter notebooks. Developers can use it to understand LLM internals, experiment with model components, and build custom language applications by modifying the provided codebase.
